content:
BUILT CoLAB, represented by Vanessa Tavares, Head of Sustainability, took part in the Portugal-Luxembourg Forum, which took place on the 5th and 6th in Luxembourg City and was organised by AICEP and the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, in collaboration with the Portuguese Embassy in Luxembourg and the Luxembourg Embassy in Portugal.

At the event, BUILT CoLAB had the opportunity to present its work as a Case Study in Sustainable Construction in Portugal, and Vanessa Tavares led the sectoral workshop on Sustainable Construction and moderated the round table. She also had the opportunity to visit the facilities of the Conseil pour le Développement Économique de la Construction (CDEC) group, namely the Institut de Formation Sectoriel du Bâtiment (IFSB) and the Neobuild Centre for Innovation in Sustainable Construction.

Over the two days of the Business Forum, various B2B meetings and networking sessions were also held, allowing BUILT CoLAB to showcase the work it has been doing in the field of sustainable construction to dozens of Portuguese and Luxembourg companies.

This initiative is particularly important since Luxembourg, with the world’s highest GDP per capita and a strong innovation and competitiveness index, is a strategic economic HUB at the heart of Europe.
